summary: Carry current B12X master into beta: compiled kernels shared across identical GPUs, portable tuning winners, reclaimed MXFP4 programs
compatibility: No user action required. Compiled-kernel artifacts move to a new format keyed by compute capability and SM count instead of the GPU's UUID, so the first start after updating compiles again; later starts reuse the artifacts on every GPU of the same model.
details: CuTe disk artifacts compiled on one GPU load on any other GPU with the same compute capability and SM count.
Tuning winners carry their program keys and can be staged and installed on other ranks with digest validation (used by vLLM's winner fetch at startup).
MXFP4 attention programs are owned and reclaimed like every other compiled program; losing tuning candidates are dropped.
NVIDIA GB10 (DGX Spark) defaults to four compiler workers; other GPUs keep eight.
